title: Automated, auditable dating of the Babylonian Astronomical Diaries with language models and astronomical tools
abstract: arXiv:2610.34297v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The Babylonian Astronomical Diaries record the sky over nearly six centuries. Many tablets are broken and have lost their date formula. Experts dated many of them one tablet at a time in the standard edition, Astronomical Diaries and Related Texts from Babylonia (ADART). They used the recorded sky and other evidence, such as year formulas and royal names. Our system automates the astronomical part for all tablets with the same rules. A rule-based parser turns the recorded observations into clauses, short statements with fixed fields. A language model checks them against the text and adds observations that the parser missed. Astronomical tools test the clauses in all 701 years from 626 BCE to AD 75. The system ranks the years by how well they agree with the clauses. The system withholds published dates until its results are final, and the output lists the passages and computed positions behind each candidate year. On 120 dated tablets,

translated_title: 利用语言模型与天文工具对巴比伦天文日志进行自动化、可审计的断代
translated_abstract: 巴比伦天文日志记录了近六个世纪的天空观测。许多泥板残破不全，失去了其日期公式。专家们在标准版本《巴比伦天文日志及相关文本》（ADART）中逐一为许多泥板进行了断代，他们依据所记录的天象以及其他证据，如年份公式和国王名字。我们的系统以统一的规则为所有泥板自动化了这一天文断代过程。基于规则的解析器将记录的观测转化为子句，即具有固定字段的简短陈述。语言模型对照原文检查这些子句，并补充解析器遗漏的观测内容。天文工具在从公元前626年到公元75年的全部701年间逐一检验这些子句。系统根据子句与各年份天象的吻合程度对候选年份进行排序。系统在结果最终确定之前不采信已发表的日期，且输出中列出每个候选年份所依据的原文段落和计算出的天体位置。在120块已有日期的泥板上，（摘要在此处中断）
tldr: 本文提出一个结合规则解析器、语言模型和天文计算工具的自动化系统，可对缺失日期的巴比伦天文日志泥板进行可审计、可追溯的天文断代。
en_tdlr: This paper presents an automated, auditable system combining a rule-based parser, a language model, and astronomical tools to date the Babylonian Astronomical Diaries tablets by ranking candidate years against recorded sky observations.
